subject.title: [Feature]: Self-hosted STT/TTS provider support in webchat (Route webchat TTS through the gateway instead of browser Speech API)

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical tracker while TTS Read aloud and provider-backed editable dictation land as separate narrower PRs?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the remaining solution crosses UI, provider routing, microphone privacy, and security-boundary choices that automation should not collapse into one unsponsored design.

options.title: Keep broad tracker and split fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open, review a refreshed Gateway-backed Read aloud PR for the TTS half, and route editable dictation through the narrower https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98026 / https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 path.

options.title: Narrow this issue to TTS only
options.body: Retitle or rescope this issue around per-message Gateway-backed Read aloud and make editable dictation the canonical STT tracker elsewhere.

options.title: Convert to unified Talk/WebChat redesign
options.body: Pause the partial fixes and define a single maintainer-approved WebChat voice-mode direction across Talk, batch dictation, and manual TTS playback.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker and split fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, review a refreshed Gateway-backed Read aloud PR for the TTS half, and route editable dictation through the narrower https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98026 / https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 path.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history signal and owns the open Read aloud candidate connected to this issue.
